what_it_does: Tomahawk Ultra is a networking switch optimized for AI data centers. When multiple computers train large AI models together, they need to exchange data very quickly and with minimal delay. This chip acts as the central switch that routes all that traffic between servers. It achieves extremely low latency (sub-microsecond—faster than a blink) and high bandwidth (the ability to move a lot of data per second). The switch uses direct-path forwarding (forwarding packets in a single pass with minimal buffering) and smart traffic prioritization to handle the complex communication patterns that AI training requires.
